desc: Ideation: choose moving-column frontier DP with invariants F[k] correct for k<=cur and G[k] correct for k>=cur.

Implement the full moving-column frontier DP solution in Python (orientation/transposition, flattened A/F/G with virtual columns, initial DP, vertical/right/left updates, optimized O(R) loops) and verify it on both samples plus small random brute-force tests, reporting the sample verdict.
Performance is acceptable under the constraints (O(HW + Q*min(H,W)) with HW <= 200000), so no further optimization task is needed.
